include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# testchild.exe is all Rust (testchild-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/testchild-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# testchild.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/testchild-rust/src/testchild/testchild.rs)
add_cargo_module(testchild testchild-cargo testchild.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE testchild-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32)
